service.description: Purge old LLM call logs, messages, and conversations. Messages first so the LlmMessage FK to LlmConversation is not violated.
Return an owned Open Responses request snapshot with ordered input items and content parts.

actions.script: import org.moqui.entity.EntityCondition def requestValue = ec.entity.find("moqui.llm.LlmRequest") .condition("llmRequestId", llmRequestId).disableAuthz().one() if (!requestValue) return boolean owner = (requestValue.ownerUserId && requestValue.ownerUserId == ec.user.userId) || ec.user.isInGroup("ADMIN") if (!owner) { ec.message.addError("Not authorized for LLM request ${requestValue.llmRequestId}") return } List itemList = ec.entity.find("moqui.llm.LlmItem") .condition("llmRequestId", requestValue.llmRequestId) .orderBy("sequenceNum").disableAuthz().list() def itemIds = itemList.collect { it.llmItemId }.findAll { it } List contentList = itemIds ? ec.entity.find("moqui.llm.LlmContent") .condition("llmItemId", EntityCondition.IN, itemIds) .orderBy(["llmItemId", "contentKind", "sequenceNum"]).disableAuthz().list() : [] Map contentByItem = [:].withDefault { [content:[], summary:[], output:[]] } contentList.each { part -> String kind = part.contentKind in ["summary", "output"] ? part.contentKind : "content" contentByItem[part.llmItemId][kind] << [ contentType:part.contentType, purposeEnumId:part.purposeEnumId, text:part.textContent, refusal:part.refusal, imageUrl:org.moqui.impl.llm.LlmDataUpgrade.safeMedia(part.imageUrl), fileUrl:org.moqui.impl.llm.LlmDataUpgrade.safeMedia(part.fileUrl), videoUrl:org.moqui.impl.llm.LlmDataUpgrade.safeMedia(part.videoUrl), filename:part.filename, detail:part.detail, contentLocation:org.moqui.impl.llm.LlmDataUpgrade.safeMedia(part.contentLocation), mediaType:part.mediaType, contentLength:part.contentLength, contentSha256:part.contentSha256, annotationsJson:part.annotationsJson, logprobsJson:part.logprobsJson] } request = [ llmRequestId:requestValue.llmRequestId, conversationId:requestValue.conversationId, runId:requestValue.runId, profileName:requestValue.profileName, model:requestValue.model, protocolName:requestValue.protocolName, operation:requestValue.operation, specVersion:requestValue.specVersion, schemaSha256:requestValue.schemaSha256, previousProviderResponseId:requestValue.previousProviderResponseId, inputShape:requestValue.inputShape, localStatusEnumId:requestValue.localStatusEnumId, httpStatus:requestValue.httpStatus, referenceId:item.referenceId, content:contentByItem[item.llmItemId].content, summary:contentByItem[item.llmItemId].summary, outputContent:contentByItem[item.llmItemId].output] }), requestOptionsJson:requestValue.requestOptionsJson, effectiveOptionsJson:requestValue.effectiveOptionsJson, toolsJson:requestValue.toolsJson, requestPayloadJson:requestValue.requestPayloadJson, metadataJson:requestValue.metadataJson, errorJson:requestValue.errorJson ]

service.description: Return an owned Open Responses snapshot with ordered output items, content parts and optional stream events.

parameter.name: ownerUserId
parameter.description: Only for an administrator; others always see their own.

actions.script: import org.moqui.entity.EntityCondition if (!llmResponseId && (!providerResponseId || !profileName)) { ec.message.addError("llmResponseId or providerResponseId with profileName is required") return } // a provider id is not unique across owners: a lookup by it is always scoped to one owner String lookupOwner = ec.user.isInGroup("ADMIN") && ownerUserId ? ownerUserId : ec.user.userId Map responseCondition = llmResponseId ? [llmResponseId:llmResponseId] : [providerResponseId:providerResponseId, profileName:profileName, ownerUserId:lookupOwner] def responseValue = ec.entity.find("moqui.llm.LlmResponse") .condition(responseCondition).orderBy("-createdDate").limit(1).disableAuthz().list()[0] if (!responseValue) return def conv = responseValue.conversationId ? ec.entity.find("moqui.llm.LlmConversation") .condition("conversationId", responseValue.conversationId).disableAuthz().one() : null String ownerUserId = responseValue.ownerUserId ?: conv?.userId boolean owner = (ownerUserId && ownerUserId == ec.user.userId) || ec.user.isInGroup("ADMIN") if (!owner) ec.message.addError("Not authorized for LLM response ${responseValue.llmResponseId}") if (!owner) return List itemList = ec.entity.find("moqui.llm.LlmItem") .condition("llmResponseId", responseValue.llmResponseId) .orderBy("sequenceNum").disableAuthz().list() def itemIds = itemList.collect { it.llmItemId }.findAll { it } List contentList = itemIds ? ec.entity.find("moqui.llm.LlmContent") .condition("llmItemId", EntityCondition.IN, itemIds) .orderBy(["llmItemId", "contentKind", "sequenceNum"]).disableAuthz().list() : [] Map contentByItem = [:].withDefault { [content:[], summary:[], output:[]] } contentList.each { part -> String kind = part.contentKind in ["summary", "output"] ? part.contentKind : "content" contentByItem[part.llmItemId][kind] << [ contentType:part.contentType, purposeEnumId:part.purposeEnumId, text:part.textContent, refusal:part.refusal, imageUrl:org.moqui.impl.llm.LlmDataUpgrade.safeMedia(part.imageUrl), fileUrl:org.moqui.impl.llm.LlmDataUpgrade.safeMedia(part.fileUrl), videoUrl:org.moqui.impl.llm.LlmDataUpgrade.safeMedia(part.videoUrl), filename:part.filename, detail:part.detail, contentLocation:org.moqui.impl.llm.LlmDataUpgrade.safeMedia(part.contentLocation), mediaType:part.mediaType, contentLength:part.contentLength, contentSha256:part.contentSha256, annotationsJson:part.annotationsJson, logprobsJson:part.logprobsJson] } response = [ llmResponseId:responseValue.llmResponseId, providerResponseId:responseValue.providerResponseId, conversationId:responseValue.conversationId, runId:responseValue.runId, callId:responseValue.callId, profileName:responseValue.profileName, model:responseValue.model, specVersion:responseValue.specVersion, objectType:responseValue.objectType, status:responseValue.status, llmRequestId:responseValue.llmRequestId, previousProviderResponseId:responseValue.previousProviderResponseId, finishReason:responseValue.finishReason, httpStatus:responseValue.httpStatus, promptTokens:responseValue.promptTokens, completionTokens:responseValue.completionTokens, totalTokens:responseValue.totalTokens, cachedInputTokens:responseValue.cachedInputTokens, reasoningOutputTokens:responseValue.reasoningOutputTokens, createdDate:responseValue.createdDate, completedDate:responseValue.completedDate, optionsJson:responseValue.optionsJson, usageJson:responseValue.usageJson, errorJson:responseValue.errorJson, incompleteDetailsJson:responseValue.incompleteDetailsJson, metadataJson:responseValue.metadataJson, payloadJson:responseValue.payloadJson, items:(itemList.collect { item -> [ llmItemId:item.llmItemId, sequenceNum:item.sequenceNum, providerItemId:item.providerItemId, itemType:item.itemType, status:item.status, role:item.role, phase:item.phase, providerCallId:item.providerCallId, toolName:item.toolName, argumentsJson:item.argumentsJson, outputJson:item.outputJson, createdBy:item.createdBy, referenceId:item.referenceId, content:contentByItem[item.llmItemId].content, summary:contentByItem[item.llmItemId].summary, outputContent:contentByItem[item.llmItemId].output] }) ] int pageSize = (eventLimit != null ? eventLimit : 500) as int int pageStart = (eventOffset != null ? eventOffset : 0) as int if (pageSize < 1 || pageSize > 1000) { ec.message.addError("eventLimit must be between 1 and 1000"); return } if (pageStart < 0) { ec.message.addError("eventOffset must not be negative"); return } if (includeEvents) { def eventPage = ec.entity.find("moqui.llm.LlmResponseEvent") .condition("llmResponseId", responseValue.llmResponseId) .orderBy("localSequenceNum").offset(pageStart).limit(pageSize + 1).disableAuthz().list() if (eventPage.size() > pageSize) { response.eventsNext = pageStart + pageSize; eventPage = eventPage.subList(0, pageSize) } response.events = eventPage.collect { evt -> [ eventType:evt.eventType, sequenceNum:evt.sequenceNum, providerSequenceNum:evt.providerSequenceNum, localSequenceNum:evt.localSequenceNum, providerResponseId:evt.providerResponseId, providerItemId:evt.providerItemId, outputIndex:evt.outputIndex, contentIndex:evt.contentIndex, terminal:evt.terminal, eventDate:evt.eventDate, payloadJson:evt.payloadJson] } }

service.description: Claim expired runs owned by the current user and resume only checkpoints safe from duplicate effects.
Periodic local worker that resumes expired runs under each persisted owner identity.

For an installation that already holds Open Responses data from before the options and usage were kept apart: bring stored responses to the current layout, a batch at a time (administrator only). Run it again with lastLlmResponseId of the previous result while more is true; it is safe to repeat and to interrupt. Back up first; see framework/plans/OpenResponses.md.

Look at the runs of the current user that wait for the provider to finish a background response, and complete the ones that are due and finished. Needs a provider that can read a response; one that cannot is left as it is. It never creates a response.

actions.script: context.putAll(org.moqui.impl.llm.LlmBackgroundPoller.poll(ec, workerId, leaseSeconds as int, limit as int))

service.description: Scheduled: poll the waiting background responses of every owner, each as that owner.

actions.script: context.putAll(org.moqui.impl.llm.LlmBackgroundPoller.pollAll(ec, workerId, leaseSeconds as int, limit as int))

service.description: For an installation that stored Open Responses content before the media columns were encrypted: write the image, file and video locations of stored content as ciphertext, a batch at a time (administrator only). Run it again with lastLlmContentId of the previous result while more is true; it is safe to repeat and to interrupt. Back up first; see framework/plans/OpenResponses.md.

For an installation that stored Open Responses responses before the error, metadata and incomplete-details columns were encrypted: write them as ciphertext, a batch at a time (administrator only). Run it again with lastLlmResponseId of the previous result while more is true; it is safe to repeat and to interrupt. Back up first.

Move conversations of an Open Responses profile that were stored as a transcript of messages to the item model, a batch at a time (administrator only). The trajectory comes from the latest completed run of the conversation; old message rows are deleted only when they are a copy of it, and are otherwise kept and never read again. A conversation without a completed run is reported in withoutSource and left as it is. Run it again with lastConversationId of the previous result while more is true. Back up first; see framework/plans/OpenResponses.md.
Project the caller's stored content that has no searchable copy yet, a batch at a time. Run it again with lastLlmContentId of the previous result while more is true; it can be repeated safely.
Retrieve an owned provider response when the configured provider advertises the extension.
Cancel an owned provider response when the configured provider advertises the extension.
List input items for an owned provider response when supported.
